text: The company reported record revenue and profit above expectations.
Management raised its full-year earnings outlook after strong demand.
The firm won a major contract that is expected to increase future sales.
Operating margins improved while debt declined substantially.
The company posted a larger loss and cut its revenue forecast.
Sales fell sharply after the firm lost its largest customer.
Regulators imposed a significant fine following an accounting investigation.
Cash flow weakened and management warned of continued uncertainty.
The board scheduled its annual shareholder meeting for next month.
The company published its quarterly financial statements on Tuesday.
A director resigned and a replacement will be appointed at the next meeting.
The firm announced that its registered office address has changed.
